focus_points: Compare only viable architectural paths inside the bounded package.
Name the recommended path and the main tradeoff behind that choice.
State whether the path improves or regresses performance, elegance, and structural soundness.
For each material finding, add category and formalizable-hint when you can judge them honestly.

When assessing design, seek the simplest faithful Clean Code/SOLID design for the approved intent. Do not invent future-facing work or erase explicit TODO intent. Planning review may challenge proposed intent; delivery review must preserve approved intent or return for renewed approval.
historical_disposition_policy: Resolved findings are historical context only. Do not reopen them unless the current bounded package materially changes the same locus/behavior or fresh evidence shows regression.
Challenged findings stay closed unless the current bounded package materially changes the same locus/behavior or the prior rationale is objectively insufficient.
Deferred findings must cite the recorded follow-up/waiver path first. Re-raise them only when the current bounded package changes the same locus or closure now depends on that deferred risk.
Unresolved findings remain valid to re-raise until they are fixed, challenged, or formally deferred with authority.
goal: Adjudicate ONLY OPS-R4-01 as an architectural HOW/contract ambiguity, without changing WHAT or waiving mandatory TODO guarantees. A late explicit refresh failure without context/fence metadata can mark newer passive successful evidence unavailable; status/time/fence remain truthful, no send occurs, and a later explicit refresh recovers. Is this a concrete mandatory D07/D08 violation requiring current correction, or an honestly conservative local availability false-negative that may be recorded nonblocking for the approved trusted local cohort? Cite exact frozen contract and producer/error shape; do not accept a defect merely to save time or require every marginal improvement. If correction is necessary, give simplest faithful options A/B/C with metadata ownership/consumer semantics/test target and whether approval renewal is actually required. Do not invent arrival-order or request-start-fence authority, suppress genuine current failure, add a parallel state owner/framework, or reopen unchanged ACK/backend/read-budget design without new concrete evidence. Separately acknowledge SEC-R35-01 has its own blocking test handoff, not the subject of this opinion. Full applicable performance/elegance/structural/operational lenses and residual risk; no tools or independent reproduction claims. Return strict result JSON; reasoning may use structured sections within overall_assessment.
